notes: Restore opaque, high-contrast CoinKeeper import dialog and readable selections in light and dark UI.
Explain CSV recipient 'В' as probably Vika, without auto-classifying as a RUDI expense category.
Allow the owner to delete the last imported CoinKeeper CSV by one confirmed action, even if the upload only partially completed.
Deletion only removes matching entries from the isolated historical archive; live categories, wallets, balances and expenses are unchanged.
Add automated regression coverage for archive rollback and UI accessibility.
versionPolicy: Один пакет изменений = один production deploy. Сначала проверка и PR, затем подтверждение пользователя.
